where: Section 2 (two-way binding sentence) and exam traps item 4
problem: The text says the field "must be observable" for @= and that using @= on a non-observable field makes "write-back silently do nothing". Write-back (view to object) works with a plain field too; observability is needed only for the object-to-view direction, so a plain field stores the typed text but never redraws the view from the model.
fix: Say: @= copies what the user types into the object; the expression must be assignable and the types must match. Make the field observable (ObservableField, LiveData, or BaseObservable with @Bindable) as well, otherwise a change made in code will not update the EditText.

problem: The question is garbled: "State one thing view binding can do and data binding can do that view binding cannot" reads as one item and hides that two answers are wanted.
fix: State one thing view binding can do, and one thing data binding can do that view binding cannot.
